name: place-440-noteleport
note: FAMILY A, THE ISOLATOR - AND THE ONE CARD IN THE LADDER WHOSE OUTCOME IS GENUINELY UNKNOWN. A placement carries TWO things at once and R43 could not separate them: the entry SPEED, and a vertical TELEPORT. Per LAW-LEDGER.md X32 a lane spawns at startAlt +/- DroneAltDeckM/2 and PlaceOnCondition then teleports it to startAlt, so hs-hold's declared 'deck spread' was never an altitude spread - it was a 1500 m displacement applied to every lane at t=0, on top of writing 440 m/s into the rigid body. The rest of the ladder holds that displacement fixed at R43's 1500 m and varies speed. THIS CARD DOES THE OPPOSITE: identical airframe, identical geometry, identical 440 m/s, DroneAltDeckM = 0. Read TestDrone.DeckSpreadM and TestDrone.RingRadius before doubting it - the deck value is a SPREAD about startAlt, not an offset, so 0 collapses the fleet to ONE deck at exactly startAlt and the placement's vertical displacement is zero. The ring radius does not move with it: at 2 lanes both the one-deck and two-deck formulas are bound by the AbeamM 5000 m floor, so the deck is the only thing that changes between this card and 'place-440'. EITHER RESULT IS THE ANSWER, and this card deliberately declares no PASS side. LANES SURVIVE -> the teleport is a NECESSARY CO-FACTOR: the ceiling is about placement DISPLACEMENT at speed, not about speed alone, the whole ladder's rungs are measuring speed x 1500 m rather than speed, and the harness fix is to place at the spawn altitude. LANES DIE ANYWAY -> speed alone is sufficient, the ladder's rungs mean what they say, and the rung that first dies is the true ceiling. A 10-of-10 death here is as informative as a 10-of-10 survival; what would be uninformative is a split, which at n=10 would say the transient is marginal at 440 and the bracket needs the finer rungs. PAIRED ARM: 'place-440' (same everything, DroneAltDeckM = 3000). Fly BOTH or neither - a one-armed run here reproduces R43's ambiguity in a new place. The R43 arm exists (3 of 3 dead) but crosses a batch boundary, which is precisely what Family C is in the queue to test. count 2 for the same reason as place-400/420: ten draws, 3 s of stagger. THROTTLE 0.92 is (440/460)^2 off R43's single trim datum and is a first estimate - immaterial if the lane dies at t=0, and to be re-cut from the capture if it does not.
